list.title: c-hls-dash-video-processor
list.description: A small C CLI that validates a source video, generates adaptive bitrate MP4 variants, extracts audio when present, creates a thumbnail, and packages the result as HLS or combined HLS + DASH. It relies on libavformat/libavcodec for metadata and libgpac for processing and packaging.

list.title: c_snellslens
list.description: Raylib demo that simulates a glass lens using Snell's law in vector form, with CPU and GPU shader implementations.

list.title: micro_market
list.description: A small microservices demo built around checkout, inventory, and invoice workflows. The repo mixes Go and C services: checkout and inventory focus on request handling and telemetry, while invoice-service stores invoice data in SQLite, listens to Redis events, and generates PDFs in C.

list.title: Mandelbrot_Fractal_Renderer
list.description: Classic complex-plane fractals: Mandelbrot, Julia, and Newton.

list.title: fluid_Simulation
list.description: A passion project implementing an Eulerian fluid solver in C, inspired by my studies in physics and computer science. This is an in-progress simulator that captures fluid motion, incompressibility, and smoke advection.

list.title: go-particle_simulation
list.description: A Go and Raylib particle simulation using cellular automata, inspired by falling sand games and Noita.

list.title: waview
list.description: A simple C and Raylib audio visualizer.

list.title: c_spectrogram
list.description: A high-performance STFT spectrogram visualizer in C with a custom radix-2 FFT, Hamming windowing, and real-time Raylib rendering.

list.title: go-fft-raylib-impl
list.description: A high-performance 2D FFT in Go using the Cooley-Tukey algorithm for image frequency-domain analysis.

list.title: ffmpeg_ply
list.description: A simple ffplay clone in C using FFmpeg and SDL.

list.title: go-hls-dash-video-processor
list.description: A Go video service that transcodes videos into HLS and MPEG-DASH with FFmpeg.

list.title: yt_captions_download
list.description: A Go tool for downloading and converting YouTube captions/subtitles into multiple formats.

list.title: omailer
list.description: A minimal Go library for sending HTML email over SMTP with inline styling.

list.title: hls_downloader
list.description: A robust and feature-rich HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) downloader written in Go, inspired by hls-downloader.

list.title: spock-websocket
list.description: a simple websocket server that can be used to send messages to clients in real time. The project consists of a websocket server written in Go, a web client written in HTML, CSS, and Javascript, and a mobile app written in Flutter.

list.title: VTT-Untertitle-parser
list.description: A handy tool to parse the untertitles of the movies and series that I watch and translate them to English or any other language of your choice.

list.title: ocpp-emulator-go
list.description: This is a dummy OCPP charging point implementation in Golang. It is a simple implementation that can be used to test OCPP 1.6 central systems.

list.title: hack_vm_translator
list.description: A VM translator for Nand2Tetris that converts stack-based VM code to Hack assembly language. Implements both Project 7 (basic stack operations) and Project 8 (program flow and function calling) functionality.

list.title: hack_assembler_go
list.description: A Go implementation of a Hack assembler that converts assembly code to binary machine code for the Hack computer architecture (Nand2Tetris Project 6).

list.title: clean_flutter_build
list.description: Clean Flutter apps and reduce code size to free disk space.

list.title: gr_zoom
list.description: A Flutter plugin for Zoom Client SDK.

list.title: security_tester
list.description: A Flutter library that detects suspicious apps and abnormal environments.

list.title: flutter_socket_io_chat
list.description: A demo app that teaches how to build a simple Socket.IO chat.
